panel_occupancy_constraints.note: Physical panel limits must be validated per ship and patch.

destination_grouping_rules.logic: Group cargo by delivery destination before optimizing by commodity.

container_size_awareness.logic: Container size and mission packaging should be tracked separately from nominal ship SCU.

unloading_sequence_optimization.logic: Sequence cargo so the next stop is easiest to unload.

practical_human_operator_handling_limits.note: Operational complexity should be minimized even when theoretical cargo capacity permits more stacking.
